# FS-31's matrix (SMTP-M9-30)

Written by `TestFs31MatrixTable` from `fs31_test.go`'s rows, which fails when this file differs; set `SMTPPROOF_WRITE_FS31` to rewrite it. Each row runs in every cell it names, through the leg's edge: the real engine (`smtpedgeservice`) with smtpproof's Verifier, whose session is `edgeSession`, under `sidecar_testhooks`, and `edgeSession` alone with each part's circuit on gnark's solver beside the relation in the plain leg; a row marked T3 also runs on server's stores through `server/cli/smtpedge/fs31_test.go`. Every row's MX is sidecartest's ScriptedMx or RecordMx, whose record of accepted commands and transactions is the assertion: a row that is not delivered leaves no transaction and no command accepted inside TLS but the honest dialog's, none past what the parts before the refused one opened. A run's own results, with the tier it ran on, go to its log, and to the file `SMTPPROOF_FS31_MATRIX` names.
